title: Journeys
description: The SLOs and one row per journey J1-J5 at its BFF routes: success, p95 latency and burn rate (platform LLD §8.8; PAY-NFR-04, 05, 06).

panels.title: Availability, 30 days
panels.description: Non-5xx share of J1-J5 BFF requests (health and telemetry routes excluded, C4). Target 99.5%.

panels.title: Error budget remaining, 30 days
panels.description: 1 - (30-day error ratio / 0.005). Below 0 means the SLO is missed for the window.

panels.title: Burn rate (1 h, 6 h, 5 m)
panels.description: Error ratio / 0.005. BffAvailabilityFastBurn pages when 1 h and 5 m are both above 14.4 (line); BffAvailabilitySlowBurn opens a ticket when 6 h and 30 m are above 6.

panels.title: p95 latency: reads and simple writes
panels.description: sli:bff_latency_p95:5m against the 300 ms objective (PAY-NFR-05).

panels.title: p95 latency: calculate and approve
panels.description: sli:bff_latency_heavy_p95:5m against the 1.5 s objective (PAY-NFR-05).

panels.title: p95 settlement time (approve to final)
panels.description: sli:payout_settlement_p95:1h against the 60 s objective (PAY-NFR-06).
